scientific_integrity: The analytic gap-sign proof proves the cutoff classification for all strict interior cutoffs; finite rational checks and Wigner samples corroborate rather than replace it. No independent mathematical audit has been performed.

title: Three sharp extremal transitions in spin-two cubic concentration on antipodal caps
